rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Dev, Eli, Ben, Fay, Cal, Ada. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Dev.say: Dev here. I'm claiming 5 rations, exactly enough to eat one a night through all 5 nights. Everyone else: each of you needs 5 to survive. Please claim only what you need so the rest of the storehouse can cover the others, and let's share surplus once we see the delivery.

Eli.say: Eli here. Everyone starts with nothing and the storehouse can't feed all six for five nights, so let's coordinate. I'm claiming 6 today so I can hold enough to survive the nights. Any rations I end up with beyond my own five needs, I'll give to whoever is closest to starving. Please tell us what you're claiming and holding so we can plan who survives.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone eats 1 ration a night and we all start at 0, so each of us needs at least 1 claimed today to survive tonight. Proposal: each of us claims exactly 1 today. That's 6 total, which fits in the storehouse under any delivery (10 to 14 available), so everyone gets 1 and nobody has to go hungry. Let's keep claims to what we need each day so the storehouse lasts for all five nights, and any spare rations get shared with whoever is short.

Fay.say: Fay here. Proposal: everyone claims only 1 ration today, enough to eat tonight. With 6 claims of 1, the full claims are met from the storehouse (10 to 14 available), so nobody is shortchanged and nobody over-claims. Whatever is left stays in storehouse for later days. Let's share fairly and give spare rations to anyone who runs out.

Cal.say: Cal here. Total need is 30 rations for six people over five nights, and we likely can't cover everyone. Proposal: two of us claim 5 each today, which is fully covered since at least 10 will be available. Those two then keep their own rations, and later surplus gets shared with others so more of us survive. I'm claiming 5 now. Please say what you're claiming so we can plan the next rounds.

Ada.say: Ada here. Proposal: we all claim only what we eat each night (1 ration each), so the storehouse covers everyone every day. Today the pool is at least 10, so six claims of 1 are all filled in full. Anyone holding spare rations, please share with whoever is short before nightfall. Let's all survive to day 5.

Dev.say: Dev here. Status: Ben and Fay are dead. I hold 2, Eli 2, Cal 2, Ada 0. Four nights remain. Each of us alive needs 1 ration per night, so I need 2 more and Ada needs 4. Storehouse is empty now, so today's claims come only from the delivery (4 to 8). I'm claiming only my 2 needed. Ada, claim your full 4, since you hold nothing. Eli and Cal, please claim only what you're short. Whoever ends up with spare rations later should give them to Ada first.

Eli.say: Eli here. We're down to four: Dev, Eli, Cal, Ada. I hold 2 and need 2 more to last the four nights. Ada holds nothing and needs 4, so the storehouse can't cover everyone. Today's pool is only the delivery (4 to 8). I'm claiming just my 2, so we don't split it on claims I can't fill. Dev and Cal, please claim only your 2 each. Ada, please claim what you can. Whatever the rest of us end up with after tonight, let's pass spare rations to whoever is at zero so as many as possible reach day 5.

Cal.say: Cal here. We're down to four of us: Dev, Eli, Cal hold 2 each, Ada holds 0. Ada needs 1 ration tonight, so Ada please claim exactly 1. Dev, Eli and I each need 2 more to last the four remaining nights, so each of us should claim 2 today. Whatever gets delivered beyond that, let's pass it along to whoever is short. I'll keep my own 2 for tonight and share any surplus I receive.

Ada.say: Ada here. Ben and Fay have died, so four of us remain: Dev, Eli, Cal, Ada. Storehouse is empty and today's delivery is 4 to 8. I'm claiming only 1, which is what I need to eat tonight (I hold 0). Four claims of 1 fit under the minimum delivery of 4, so everyone living gets filled in full. Dev, Eli and Cal each hold 2, which covers two nights; they'll need 2 more each. Let's keep claims to exactly 1 each per night until the stores are steady, and anyone with spare rations gives to whoever is at zero.

Dev.say: Dev here. I now hold 3, which covers my three remaining nights exactly, so I'm claiming nothing today. Ada is the only one short: she holds 0 and needs 3. Ada, claim your full 3; today's delivery (at least 4) covers it in full. Eli and Cal, you also hold 3 each, so claim nothing unless you're short. Anyone with rations left after their own needs should give them to Ada.

Eli.say: Eli here. Dev, Cal and I each hold 3, which is exactly enough for the three nights left, so none of us needs to claim anything. Ada holds 0 and needs 3 to survive. Ada, please claim 3 today. The delivery is at least 4, so that's filled in full, and it leaves the storehouse ready for tonight's and tomorrow's needs. The rest of us will hold to our own rations and won't claim, so the storehouse goes to Ada.

Ada.say: Ada here. All four of us now hold 2, which covers the two nights left. Nobody needs to claim anything today, so I'm claiming nothing. Dev.say: Dev here. Final night. Each of us holds 1 ration, which covers tonight. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Eat your own ration tonight and we all reach day 5 alive.

Eli.say: Eli here. Each of us holds 1, which is exactly tonight's ration. I'm eating my own tonight and claiming nothing. The storehouse has 12 plus today's delivery, so no one needs anything from it. Let's all see morning.

Cal.say: Cal here. Last night. Each of us holds 1, which is exactly what we need to eat tonight. Everyone should eat their own ration. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing.

Ada.say: Ada here. Last night. Each of us holds 1, which is exactly one ration for tonight. Eat your own and everyone reaches the end. The storehouse holds 12, so there's plenty in reserve if anyone's count is off. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing.
